title: arabis procurrens var. vochinensis
intro: Arabis procurrens var. vochinensis, commonly known as Chinese rockcress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, headache, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Arabis procurrens var. vochinensis include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and glucosinolates, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
